brief.app_summary: Alerta monitoring application with a Vue frontend, Python API, and PostgreSQL storage. Users register and log in with email/password.

components.name: webui
components.role: Vue static website built from the pinned frontend commit

components.name: api
components.role: Alerta Python API with authenticated signup and login

components.name: caddy
components.role: HTTPS certificates, static files, and same-origin API reverse proxy

brief.topology: Dedicated VPC and subnet; one Melbourne VM runs Caddy, Alerta API and PostgreSQL in Compose. Only HTTP/HTTPS are public. SSH uses IAP. PostgreSQL data and secret files live on a separate persistent disk; services restart automatically.
brief.resource_rationale: Small single-server deployment suits assumed light traffic and requires few paid resources. Separate retained data disk meets restart durability; Caddy manages HTTPS without a paid load balancer.

heavier_alternatives.why_unnecessary: No multi-server scheduling or scaling requirement was supplied.
PostgreSQL on retained storage meets restart persistence; managed database adds recurring cost.
Caddy on the VM terminates HTTPS for this single hostname.

assumptions: Initial traffic is light; single VM availability is sufficient.
User delegated region choice; Melbourne chosen near <LOCAL_INSTITUTION>.
User delegated admin choice; reserve admin role for active gcloud account email.
Open email/password signup without email verification; reserve admin account before DNS release; no SMTP setup requested.

tiers.name: Small (recommended)
tiers.composition: e2-small 2 GiB VM, 20 GiB standard boot disk, 20 GiB retained standard data disk, one static IPv4, dedicated VPC/subnet and web/IAP firewall rules
tiers.load_assumption: Light traffic, a few concurrent users
tiers.uncertainty: Fixed base about USD20.56/month at 730 hours; traffic, tax and currency conversion extra; estimated range is not a spending cap.

tiers.name: More memory
tiers.composition: Same resources with e2-medium 4 GiB VM
tiers.load_assumption: More memory headroom for modest activity
tiers.uncertainty: Fixed base about USD35.31/month at 730 hours; traffic, tax and currency conversion extra; estimated range is not a spending cap.
